plainText:
Kōichi Sakaguchi (Japanese: 坂口候一 Sakaguchi Kōichi) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Sakaguchi was born on February 10, 1968 in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined early on, playing various roles, usually as Pokémon. His most prominent roles are those of , as well as Raoul Contesta.
